etymologies.etymologyHTML: From bio- +‎ chemistry.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) The chemistry of those compounds that occur in living organisms, and the processes that occur in their metabolism and catabolism
(countable) The chemical characteristics of a particular living organism

quote.citation: 2012, Caspar Henderson, The Book of Barely Imagined Beings, page 146:
quote.text: They [viruses] use more varied biochemistry than cellular life, storing their genetic information as both single- and double-stranded DNA as well as RNA.

definitions.definition: (countable) The biochemical activity associated with a particular chemical or condition
